This file governs RusToK contributors and AI agents.

1. Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md).
2. Review domain module documentation before changes.
3. Use module owners (or the platform team) for cross-cutting approvals.
4. Record architecture decisions in `DECISIONS/` using an ADR.
5. Do not create a new document when an existing one is suitable — extend it instead.
6. Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code.
7. Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures.
8. Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested.
9. Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.

Ownership: platform: `crates/rustok-core`, `apps/server`, shared infra; domains: `crates/rustok-*`; frontends: `apps/admin`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/next-admin`, `apps/next-frontend`; MCP: `crates/rustok-mcp`; tooling: `scripts/`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `grafana/`, `prometheus/`. See [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md).

Docs: central `docs/` is Russian; public contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and crate `README.md` files are English. Mixed language within a single document is not allowed — choose one language per file. Platform docs live in `docs/`; component docs in `apps/<name>/docs/` or `crates/<name>/docs/`. Every app/crate needs root `README.md` covering purpose, responsibilities, interactions, entry points, and a `docs/` link. `docs/modules/_index.md` links module docs.

For architecture, API, events, modules, tenancy, routing, UI contracts, or observability changes: update local docs, central `docs/`, and [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md); update [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md) for added/renamed modules/apps; mark outdated docs `deprecated` or `archived` and link replacements.
